# Lee Carpenter

Lee Carpenter has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 5](https://flow.je/elections/district-5), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/11/green-finance-expert-to-stand-for-reform-jersey/)\]
